obligations.note: The change sets Policy.PRIVILEGED_IDLE_MINUTES and controls/mortgage/policy-params.json mortgage.privileged_idle_minutes to 20, but the approved catalog on base bounds mortgage.privileged_idle_minutes <= 15. The passing SessionControlTest checks against the parameter file the change itself raised, so it doesn't show compliance with the approved bound.
No exception covers this deviation: the only SES-1 exception (EXC-0141) is scoped to payments.session batch service accounts and expired 2026-09-20, before the 2026-10-20 review.

Ticket CHG-24092 was approved by change manager Grace Kim on 2026-10-16, before the change was opened, and its components (mortgage.policy, mortgage.tests, mortgage.controls-data) cover all three touched paths.
The code_review approval is from Wen Li, a baseline-mortgage change_approver who is a different person from the author Nneka Okafor.
Both approvals name the head commit b4c1e93, which is the change's only commit.
The CI run on head b4c1e93 succeeded: 124 tests, 0 failures, 0 skipped, including the registered SES-1 control test controls.SessionControlTest#privilegedIdleTimeoutWithinPolicy (exhaustive) passing.
The change edits protected controls/mortgage/policy-params.json and has a control_owner approval on head from Rachel Stein (controls-office, outside the author's lending-eng team).
Ledger entries covering Policy.java (LIM-1, CRD-1) cover UNDERWRITER_LIMIT, SENIOR_LIMIT, DTI_MAX_PERCENT and LTV_MAX_PERCENT, which are unchanged; no ledger evidence covers PRIVILEGED_IDLE_MINUTES.

summary: PR-1207 raises the Mortgage privileged session idle timeout from 15 to 20 minutes in both code and the approved policy parameter. The approved obligation catalog's SES-1 bounds this value at 15 minutes, and no valid exception covers the deviation (the only SES-1 exception is for payments and has expired). The process records (ticket, independent review, control-owner approval, CI on head) are in order, but the green control test only compares against the parameter file the change itself raised. Because SES-1 is violated, the change is rejected.
